_note: Researched return weeks for rostered players. return_week = first NFL week the player is expected to play. Maintained by the morning report run. NFL IR = minimum 4 games.

A.J. Brown.note: On IR, high-ankle sprain. Week 6 (vs NYJ) was the earliest eligible date, but Rapoport (9/22): 'the expectation is he misses six weeks' - Patriots determined the injury is more serious than the initial 4-6 wk range suggested. Realistic return is Week 8 vs MIA.

Jordan Mason.note: IR, fractured thumb, had surgery. Coach O'Connell: expects him back at the 4-week IR minimum, not longer. Aaron Jones is now Minnesota's clear lead back - Mason projects as a backup/change-of-pace role even once healthy, not a lead job.

Isiah Pacheco.note: Back surgery to remove a body pressing on a nerve; 12-week recovery with a chance he's back early December (Rapoport). Replaces the old IR-minimum Week 5 estimate. Not currently rostered in this league.
Isiah Pacheco.source: Ian Rapoport (NFL Network), ESPN, Pro Football Rumors

Zach Charbonnet.note: Reserve/PUP (ACL, Jan 17). Macdonald (9/23): Seattle will NOT open his practice window this week, 'closing in on a decision'. Eligible for Week 5 but needs a practice ramp first, so Week 5 is unlikely; Week 6 is the earliest realistic game. PFN analyst guesses Week 8 (opinion, not reported).
Zach Charbonnet.source: Mike Macdonald via RotoWire (9/23), Pro Football Network

Jordyn Tyson.note: IR (designated to return), right hamstring strain suffered ~Aug 18; NFL Network reported ~2 months out, and Saints are being cautious given his 4th hamstring injury. Week 5 is the earliest eligible date; ~8 weeks points to Week 6.

Josh Jacobs.note: Pleaded no contest Sept 10 (criminal case resolved). Remains on Commissioner's Exempt List (paid, can't play/practice); NFL confirms no timetable for discipline. Standard domestic-violence-case suspension is 6 games, could be shorter or longer.

De'Von Achane.note: Torn ACL in Week 3 loss to KC, confirmed by MRI Monday; placed on IR. Out for the season.

Caleb Williams.note: Grade 2 hamstring strain suffered Week 2 vs MIN; ruled out Week 3 (Keenum starting). Schefter/Rapoport: 3-4 week timeline, so Week 5 at the earliest (Bears call him a quick healer), Week 6 more likely.
Caleb Williams.source: Adam Schefter & Ian Rapoport via ESPN, ChicagoBears.com

Jayden Daniels.note: Dislocated left elbow in Week 2 vs DAL. No surgery, no IR (GM Adam Peters, 9/25). Rapoport (9/27): expected back within three weeks, playing in a brace. Week 5 possible, Week 6 most likely.
Jayden Daniels.source: Ian Rapoport (NFL Network), Adam Peters, CBS Sports

Travis Etienne.note: Hamstring injury in Week 3 loss to LV. Kellen Moore (Mon): will have 'time lost', no timeline given; unclear if IR. Out for Week 4 (MNF at ATL) assumed; if he goes to IR, bump to Week 8.
Travis Etienne.source: Kellen Moore via ESPN, NBC Sports (PFT)

Christian Kirk.note: Started season on IR/designated-to-return, calf injury from July 26 practice. Per NFL IR tracker, eligible to return Week 5. Expected to have a prominent role in SF's offense once back.
